conviction_note: One small sourced negative: ゴールドクレスト has held its full-year plan at every H1 and Q3 print in the visible record, even at 67.9% and 109% progress. Kabutan is again listing it as an upward-revision candidate, but the 59.8% Q1 progress behind that list is mostly a land sale announced in March and already in the plan. The margin book is 9.33x long. Last year the identical H1 setup closed -2.99% the next day. Against that, the run-in is already -6.9% (about 2.5 points of it the 80-yen ex-dividend), the yield is 5.6% at 0.68x book, and the same setup at Q1 moved +0.31%. So the lean is small: p_up 46 on an abs move of 2.5, giving -0.20. Impact_sum is -0.5 and the two numbers agree in sign.
bar: There is no H1 forecast; the company discloses only the full year. FY3/27 plan from the 2026-05-14 短信, unchanged at Q1: sales 42,000m, OP 15,900m, ordinary 14,200m, NI 9,500m, DPS 160 (interim 80). https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260514/140120260424509405.pdf and https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260731/140120260722597243.pdf. The market's own bar is retail's revision expectation (kabutan 2026-10-18 list: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8871&b=n202610180054). There is no IFIS or 四季報 number I could reach. Coverage is Nomura Buy TP 4,290 (2026-08-03) and Nikko Neutral TP 3,400 (2026-08-14). I expect H1 to land inside a held plan, hence 0.0. With no consensus to source, the findings are capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% disclosed (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-10-27 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via baseline). 信用倍率 9.33 (baseline; kabutan page 2026-10-28 also shows 9.33x), so leveraged retail is crowded long and there is no squeeze fuel. No options, no skew. priced_lean_pct -0.14 (margin overhang -0.485, run-up +0.345). The 20-day run-up is -6.9%, of which about 2.5 points is the 80-yen interim ex-dividend on 2026-09-29 (3,210 to 3,085).

findings.finding: Goldcrest does not revise its plan in-year even when it is well ahead: it held at H1 FY3/26 with ordinary profit at 67.9% of plan (stock -2.99% the next session) and at Q3 FY3/25 with 109% of plan (-0.81%). Only one in-year revision (Q3, Jan 2022) appears in four years. This year's 59.8% Q1 ordinary progress, which kabutan again lists as an upward-revision candidate, is largely the Koto-ku land sale disclosed on 2026-03-05 and delivered in May (Q1 分譲 sales 13,990m against only 1,484m of condo deliveries), which the plan already included. So the revision retail is positioned for (信用倍率 9.33) is unlikely at this print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Plan held at H1 FY3/26 despite 67.9% progress: 3,340 to 3,240, -2.99% (2025-10-31 to 11-04). Plan held at Q3 FY3/25 despite 109% progress: -0.81%. Plan held at Q1 FY3/27 with 2.3x profit: +0.31%. H1 FY3/25: +3.58%. All from Yahoo daily closes on the actual release dates.
findings.why_not_priced: Kabutan's 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-18 revision-candidate lists name 8871 on the raw 59.8% progress figure, and the margin long book is 9.33x the short book. If holders had discounted the no-revision habit and the land-sale composition, the margin long would have unwound and the stock would not be featured as a revision play. Part of it may be priced: the stock has drifted 3,110 to 2,872 since the ex-dividend date. That is why the finding is small.
findings.independence: Same company documents are read differently. The revision history on the kabutan finance page (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=8871) shows only 初/実 rows for FY3/23, FY3/24 and FY3/26, a 修 on 2025-04-30 (after year-end) for FY3/25, and one on 2022-01-27 for FY3/22. The land sale is at https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260305/140120260304576029.pdf (delivery May 2026, booked in FY3/27). Q1 短信 supplementary table: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260731/140120260722597243.pdf. All are readings of public filings, so they count as one finding.

outside_window.finding: The plan leaves room to beat at FY end. The remaining FY 分譲 plan is 29,500m - 13,990m = about 15,510m, against a condo contract backlog of 28,608m (303 units) at 2026-06-30, so the plan needs only about 54% of that backlog to deliver this year. Given the company's habit, any beat is more likely to show at Q3 or after year-end (as on 2025-04-30) than at this H1.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: not expected, given no in-year H1 revision in the visible record despite high progress; retail expects one. Returns: interim 80 yen already planned; board on record against buybacks and higher payout; no change expected. New-year guide: n/a at H1. Quarter vs own 進捗率 history: Q1 ordinary 59.8% vs 5-yr avg 41.6%, mostly the pre-announced land sale; H1 likely 65-75% vs last year's 67.9%, which drew no revision.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Strategic Capital raised its stake from 14.67% to 16.28% (report date 2026-06-30), seen as activist pressure for returns
rejected_candidates.detail: The 2026-05-15 board opinion (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260515/140120260508520901.pdf) rejects buybacks and higher payout, and the founder group controls the vote, so the stake has no path to a return announced with this print.

baseline_tension: Roughly agrees with the baseline's slight negative lean (-0.14, from the margin overhang) and cuts against nothing. The strongest positive the release could carry is a record H1 with the plan held plus confirmation of the 80-yen interim (5.6% yield at 0.68x PBR, Nomura TP 4,290), or a 悪材料出尽くし bounce after a -6.9% run-in. I looked for a buyback or dividend change and found the board on record against both. That is why p_up stays at 46 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 1: the negative rests partly on a 進捗率 and a revision habit anyone can compute from public 短信. The finding moved -0.8 to -0.5 and p_up 44 to 46, kept slightly below 50 because the release itself will show whether the plan is held.
Rule 2: I checked for the strongest positive (buyback, dividend change, held plan with record H1) and recorded it in baseline_tension. I had looked already, so this rule moved no number.
